applies_to: Lochinvar IPW units, read through the ProtoNode FPC-N54 gateway (Appendix C.8).
summary: Lochinvar's ProtoNode FPC-N54 start-up guide lists only four BACnet objects for the IPW: outlet temperature, inlet temperature and outlet voltage as analog inputs, and a writable setpoint. The IPW talks to the ProtoNode at 19200 baud, unlike the other Lochinvar products in the guide.
notes: The guide does not describe the IPW product itself; the equipment type is taken from the object list.
The table has no read/write column, units or states; access is inferred from the N2 type (AO = writable).

integration.summary: Write the setpoint to AV 4 and read outlet temperature, inlet temperature and outlet voltage.

minimum_points.name: Outlet Voltage
minimum_points.why: Outlet voltage reading (not described in the guide)

integration.enable: AV 4 Setpoint is the only writable object. The guide gives no enable object.
setup: ProtoNode FPC-N54 to the IPW: Modbus RTU, 19200 baud, no parity, 8 data bits, 1 stop bit.
Give each unit a unique Node-ID (1-255). BACnet device instance = Node_Offset (default 50,000) + Node-ID.
BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP is chosen in the ProtoNode web configurator.
gotchas: Access is inferred: the table has no read/write column.
The guide gives no units or ranges for these four objects.

source.title: ProtoNode FPC-N54 Start-up Guide For Interfacing Lochinvar Products, Appendix C.8 IPW
